card.name: Commas inside lists of drug names
card.fires_on: Commas (or 'or') right after a drug name in a list of co-administered drugs, mostly antiepileptics such as carbamazepine, phenytoin, phenobarbital. Also a few other list breaks like a colon before a drug list.

modes.label: Comma in antiepileptic list
modes.description: Comma after carbamazepine or phenytoin, just before the next anticonvulsant name.
modes.example: For women taking lamotrigine tablets in addition to carbamazepine<<,>> phenytoin, phenobarb

modes.label: Comma in other drug-class lists
modes.description: Comma after a drug name in a list of antiarrhythmics or NSAIDs.
modes.example: When lidocaine is administered with other antiarrhythmic drugs such as phenytoin<<,>> procainamide, propranolol

card.writes: It seems to push toward the next drug name in the list rather than words like plasma or sweat.
card.plain: It notices the break after one drug name in a list, where another drug name comes next.
